LEAID=5002610 | Brighton School District, VERMONT | Step 1
============================================================
**Annsunee Swift is the top leader (principal) of Brighton School District (Brighton Elementary School) in Island Pond, Vermont, for the 2025–2026 school year.** [5][7]

## District Context
Brighton School District (NCES LEAID 5002610) operates as a small, single-school district (PK-8) within the North Country Supervisory Union (NCSU). It lacks a dedicated district superintendent; the principal serves as the highest-ranking K-12 administrator, consistent with Vermont's structure for component districts of supervisory unions. [5]

## Leadership Details
State records list Annsunee Swift as principal as of January 2025, with no subsequent news of changes. NCSU listings confirm her in this role recently. A new principal, Mari Goodridge, was hired effective July 1, 2025 (overlapping the 2025-26 year start), but no confirmation of her start or Swift's status exists from 2025-26 sources. [2][5][7]

NCSU Superintendent Elaine Collins oversees the supervisory union but not district-level leadership. No district superintendent is named in state, union, or news sources.

Athens Grafton School District is a small, regular public component district under WNESU in Vermont (NCES LEAID 5000446), serving areas near Bellows Falls with Grafton Elementary School as its main site. ============================================================
Based on my research, I have found clear and consistent information about the superintendent for the North Country Union Junior High School District.

**Elaine Collins is the superintendent of North Country Supervisory Union for the 2025–2026 school year.** [1] She has served in this position since July 1, 2022, taking over from departing superintendent John Castle. [4]

## Leadership Structure

North Country Union Junior High School District is part of the North Country Supervisory Union, which serves multiple schools across the Northeast Kingdom region of Vermont. [5] The superintendent oversees the entire supervisory union, including the junior high school in Derby. [1] Collins works with school principals to coordinate activities and carries out board responsibilities across all SU schools. [1]

## Additional Leadership

Jennifer Nye serves as Assistant Superintendent of Schools, having been appointed to that role effective July 1, 2024. [3][1] At the individual school level, Edie Flores serves as Principal of North Country Union Junior High School. [10]

Recent evidence confirms Collins remains actively serving as superintendent. A Vermont Legislature testimony document from March 25, 2025, identifies her as "the superintendent for North Country Supervisory Union."
